title: Topologizing infinite quivers and their mutations
summary: We define several topological spaces whose points are quivers with a given infinite vertex set $X$. In the special case when $X$ is countably infinite, we show that two of the spaces of interest are homeomorphic to the Baire space $\mathbb{N}^\mathbb{N}$. We study properties of countably infinite quivers as subspaces of these topological spaces and prove a ``meta-theorem'' about hereditary properties of quivers.
